name: P.S. 3 ~Harem Night~
source:
Main character is an administrator of the secret web site called "PS" or "The Net". From his student years to his professor days he's been skillfully manipulating women turning them into slaves. Now he's going to train a new group of slaves thus forming his epic harem.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是秘密网站“PS”，又名“The Net”的管理员。从学生时代直到成为教授，他一直熟练地操纵女性，把她们变成奴隶。如今，他准备调教新的一批奴隶，建立自己规模宏大的后宫。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-february-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
